teaser.en: The purple-black wood of this scrubby little tree ends up in clarinets and oboes on the world's concert stages.
teaser.sw: Mbao ya rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi ya mti huu mdogo wa vichakani huishia kuwa klarineti na obo katika majukwaa ya muziki duniani.
teaser.dg: Nyama za muhi hinyu mdide wa chitsaka, za rangi ya zambarau-iru, nkuhumirwa kuhenda *clarinet* na *oboe* zinazochezwa kpwenye majukwaa ga muziki duniani kosi.

summary.en: *Mphingo*, African blackwood, is a spiny, twisted small tree of coastal bushland whose purple-black heartwood is among the most valuable timbers in the world. It is prized for carving and for musical instruments, and heavy harvesting has made it Near Threatened.
summary.sw: *Mphingo*, au mpingo, ni mti mdogo wenye miiba na uliopindapinda wa vichaka vya pwani, ambao kiini chake cha rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi ni miongoni mwa mbao zenye thamani kubwa zaidi duniani. Unathaminiwa kwa uchongaji na kwa kutengeneza ala za muziki, na uvunaji mkubwa umeufanya kuwa Karibu Kuwa Hatarini.
summary.dg: *Mphingo* ni muhi mdide wenye miya na uriodzikunja, wa vitsaka vya pwani, ambao chiinire cha rangi ya zambarau-iru ni kahi ya nyama za muhi za samani zaidi duniani. Nkuthaminiwa kpwa kutsonga na kuhenda vyombo vya muziki, na kukatwa sana kukahenda ukale kahi ya mihi iriyo *Near Threatened*.

about.en:
*Mphingo* does not look like a precious tree. It is a spiny, much-branched shrub or small tree, rarely more than 7 metres tall, with a twisted trunk and pale grey bark that flakes. The leaves are made up of small leaflets clustered at the nodes.

The value is hidden inside: the heartwood is dense and purple-black, the colour the Digo call *rangi ya mphingo*, 'ebony colour'.
about.sw:
*Mphingo* hauonekani kama mti wa thamani. Ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye miiba na matawi mengi, mara chache kuzidi mita 7 kwa urefu, wenye shina lililopindapinda na gome la kijivu hafifu linalobanduka. Majani yake yameundwa na vijani vidogo vilivyosongamana kwenye vifundo.

Thamani yake imefichwa ndani: kiini cha mbao ni kizito na cha rangi ya zambarau-nyeusi, rangi ambayo Wadigo huiita *rangi ya mphingo*, yaani rangi nyeusi ya mpingo.
about.dg:
*Mphingo* tauonekana dza muhi wa samani. Ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye miya na panda nyinji, ambao mara nyinji tauzidi mita 7 kpwa ure, wenye kolo ririrodzikunja na gopha ra rangi ya ivu ngushu-ngushu rinarotuluka vipande-vipande. Makodzage ni makodza madide ganagomera kpwa mafungu kpwenye viungo.

Samaniye i ndani: chiini ni chiziho na cha rangi ya zambarau-iru, rangi ambayo Adigo anaiiha *rangi ya mphingo*, 'rangi ya ebony'.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland, deciduous woodland and wooded grassland.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vya pwani, misitu inayopukutisha majani na nyika zenye miti.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani, matsaka ga mihi ambayo makodza gao ganagbwa, na herera zenye mihi.

uses.en:
The heartwood is among the most valuable timbers known. It is used for carving and walking sticks, and worldwide it is the wood of choice for clarinets and oboes.

The bark, roots and leaves are used in traditional medicine. The tree also gives firewood and fodder, and bees forage on its flowers.
uses.sw:
Kiini cha mbao yake ni miongoni mwa mbao zenye thamani kubwa zaidi zinazojulikana. Hutumika kwa uchongaji na kutengeneza bakora, na kote duniani ndiyo mbao inayopendelewa zaidi kwa klarineti na obo.

Gome, mizizi na majani yake hutumika katika dawa za asili. Mti huu pia hutoa kuni na lishe ya mifugo, na nyuki hutafuta chakula kwenye maua yake.
uses.dg:
Chiini ni kahi ya nyama za muhi za samani zaidi zinazomanyikana. Nkuhumirwa kutsonga na kuhenda ndata za kunyendekera, na duniani kosi ndicho chinachotsambulwa kuhenda *clarinet* na *oboe*.

Gopha, mizi na makodza nkuhumirwa dza dawa za chienyeji. Muhi hinyu piya unalavya kuni na chakurya cha kurisa nyama, na nyuchi nkuendza chakurya kpwenye maruwage.

names.en: Pakia and the Mgombato dictionary spell the Digo name *mphingo*; the ICRAF handbook writes *mpingo*, as in Swahili. Mgombato also gives the phrase *rangi ya mphingo* for the colour ebony. Other Mijikenda names are Giriama *muhingo* and Duruma *maringo*. In English it is African blackwood or African ebony. Mgombato also lists *Cyphostemma adenocaulis* under the name, which appears to be an error.
names.sw: Pakia na kamusi ya Mgombato huliandika jina la Kidigo *mphingo*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinaandika *mpingo*, kama ilivyo kwa Kiswahili. Mgombato pia inatoa usemi *rangi ya mphingo* kwa rangi nyeusi ya mpingo (*ebony*). Majina mengine ya Kimijikenda ni Kigiriama *muhingo* na Kiduruma *maringo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *African blackwood* au *African ebony*. Mgombato pia inaorodhesha *Cyphostemma adenocaulis* chini ya jina hili, jambo linaloonekana kuwa kosa.
names.dg: Pakia na kamusi ya Mgombato anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mphingo*; chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika *mpingo*, dza kpwa Chiswahili. Mgombato piya inalavya maneno *rangi ya mphingo* kpwa rangi ya ebony. Madzina ganjina ga Amijikenda ni ga Chigiriama *muhingo* na Chiduruma *maringo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *African blackwood* au *African ebony*. Mgombato piya inaandika *Cyphostemma adenocaulis* photsi ya dzina hiri, chitu chinachoonekana kukala ni kosa.

conservation.en: Mphingo is listed as Near Threatened on the IUCN Red List, and it is heavily harvested for carving.
conservation.sw: Mphingo umeorodheshwa kama Karibu Kuwa Hatarini (Near Threatened) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN, na huvunwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya uchongaji.
conservation.dg: *Mphingo* ukaandikpwa dza *Near Threatened* kpwenye Orodha ya Kundu ya IUCN, na unakatwa sana kpwa kutsonga.

reason.en: The other great carving wood, also Near Threatened
reason.sw: Muhuhu, mbao nyingine kuu ya uchongaji, nayo ni Karibu Kuwa Hatarini
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina mkulu wa kutsonga, nao piya u *Near Threatened*

reason.sw: Kiini cheusi cha mbao kinachotumika kwa uchongaji

reason.en: Premier timber, now rare from over-cutting
reason.sw: Mvule, mbao bora kabisa, sasa adimu kwa sababu ya ukataji uliopita kiasi
reason.dg: Muhi bora zaidi wa mbao, sambi ni adimu kpwa sababu ya kukatwa sana
